{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bureau of Diplomatic Liaison''' was a branch of government of the [[Troxan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troxar]]. The bureau was part of the [[Benevolence of Troxar]]. It handled [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]] for the species and sent correspondence via [[incendiary packet]]s.<ref name="YDR 2">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', Chapter 2.</ref>
